name: watakyu-video
description: 一枚のシーツから世界へ ― 職場見学 学習用解説動画（Remotion）

scripts.music: python3 tools/music.py && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i public/music/bgm.wav -c:a aac -b:a 192k public/music/bgm.m4a && rm public/music/bgm.wav
scripts.render:main: npm run glyphs && remotion render src/index.ts Main out/raw_main.mp4 && tools/finalize.sh out/raw_main.mp4 deliverables/watakyu_main.mp4
scripts.render:full: npm run glyphs && remotion render src/index.ts Full out/raw_full.mp4 && tools/finalize.sh out/raw_full.mp4 deliverables/watakyu_full.mp4
scripts.build: npm run srt && npm run docs && npm run render:main && npm run render:full
scripts.verify: python3 tools/verify_sync.py deliverables/watakyu_main.mp4 main && python3 tools/verify_sync.py deliverables/watakyu_full.mp4 full
